title: Backlash over the 2021 transients paper co-authored with Jeff Marcy

tellings.quote: in 2021 uh when we did this discovery of the nine transients uh I published a paper with my colleague Jeff Marcy. So he had been uh cancelled in a uh sexual harassment scandal in 2015.

plain: The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel says that in 2021, when her team reported nine "transients" (points of light in the sky that appear and then vanish), the paper drew a backlash partly because of her co-author. She tells Michels that she wrote it with her colleague, the astronomer Jeff Marcy, who "had been cancelled in a sexual harassment scandal in 2015." She tells it as her own experience of how the work was received in her field.
